name: Tag Along
summary: A follow button whose plus sign hops along a dotted arc onto the avatar and becomes a check badge
about: A creator profile card with a Follow button. Pressing it squashes the button and spins its plus loose; the plus flies along a dotted arc to the portrait while the button folds into a spinner. It lands as a check badge, a story ring draws round the face, your avatar joins the followed-by stack, confetti pops and the follower count rolls like an odometer. Unfollowing asks once more with a burning fuse.
how: Press Follow (or Tab to it and press Enter or Space): it squashes and the plus spins loose.
The plus flies along a dotted arc to the portrait while the button folds into a round spinner.
It lands as a check badge, the ring draws, confetti pops, your avatar joins the stack and the count rolls up.
The button opens out as Following and a bell appears: press it to get alerts and it rings.
Press Following to unfollow: it asks Unfollow? with a fuse; press again within a few seconds to confirm, or wait to keep following.
